note: Release C: the Star Wars-specific textures of the Futuristic City drawn again as generic 2070s corporate ones, with no brand names. Drawn by the local Qwen edit model.

imp_modules_id5.note: A wall-mounted building control console of a 2070s corporate arcology: a dark screen at the left, and at the right a panel of small flat status displays, touch keys and indicator lights in a clean graphite and brushed-steel housing with a thin cyan accent line. No film or franchise styling, no red plastic.

bespin_monument2.note: A tall plaza light pylon on black; the black stays black. A slim vertical white light tube beside a panel of frosted glass lit cool cyan-white, with two brushed-steel bands across it, and a small pale square lens at the lower right.

kuhmu.note: A long narrow illuminated sign strip: clean pale amber letters on a white lit panel, evenly spaced from end to end.
kuhmu.words: CONCOURSE LEVEL in plain capital Latin letters, replacing every alien glyph

ctown_build_id4.note: A block of lit office window panes of many sizes, cool white, in a dark graphite frame; the same panes in the same places.

bb3bottom.note: A pale corporate facade band: smooth light concrete panels with a row of small recessed windows and vertical brushed-steel fins.

ventilo01.note: Two round extractor fans above a louvred vent in a dark graphite steel housing.

ctown_build14.note: A pale concrete panel with a vertical ribbed brushed-steel strip down the middle.
